# orchestra_pipeline_runs (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pipeline_ids` (String) Filter by pipeline IDs (UUID4). Comma-separated for multiple values.
- `pipeline_run_ids` (String) Filter by pipeline run IDs (UUID4). Comma-separated for multiple values.
- `status` (String) Filter by pipeline run status. Comma-separated for multiple values (e.g. SUCCEEDED,FAILED).
- `time_from` (String) Start of the time range (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago if omitted. Must be specified together with time_to.
- `time_to` (String) End of the time range (ISO 8601). Defaults to now if omitted. Must be specified together with time_from. Maximum range is 7 days.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The account ID.
- `branch` (String) The Git branch used for this run.
- `child_pipeline_runs` (String) JSON string of any child pipeline runs spawned by this run.
- `commit` (String) The Git commit SHA used for this run.
- `completed_at` (String) When the pipeline run completed.
- `created_at` (String) When the pipeline run was created.
- `env_id` (String) The environment ID.
- `env_name` (String) The environment name.
- `id` (String) The pipeline run ID.
- `message` (String) A human-readable message about the pipeline run status.
- `pipeline_id` (String) The pipeline ID.
- `pipeline_name` (String) The name of the pipeline.
- `pipeline_version_number` (Number) The pipeline version number.
- `run_status` (String) The status of the pipeline run.
- `started_at` (String) When the pipeline run started executing.
- `triggered_by` (String) JSON string of trigger information for this pipeline run.
- `updated_at` (String) When the pipeline run was last updated.
